author.name: QM Bot
author.role: package marker; not the author of the commit unless --keep-bot-author is used

applyDefaults.mode: one commit on the current branch of the repository whose root holds the package folder
applyDefaults.repo: the folder that contains the package folder, which must be the root of the working tree; --repo DIR applies to the repository that contains DIR instead and the package folder may then be anywhere
applyDefaults.packageFolder: stays untracked in the repository and is never committed; .gitignore and .git/info/exclude are never edited; the script refuses when files of it are tracked or when the change touches a path inside it; it can be deleted after a successful run, the script never deletes anything
applyDefaults.author: the person who applies the package (local git user.name and user.email)
applyDefaults.committer: the person who applies the package

flags.--dry-run: apply, show the result, then undo everything
flags.--new-branch: build the commit on the local branch qm/WP-1234-b0383898e73f from the base commit in a temporary worktree; the current branch is not touched
flags.--keep-bot-author: keep the package author as the author of the commit; the applier stays the committer

applyDefaults.undo: git reset --keep <original HEAD printed by the script>, only before the commit is pushed

files.name: apply.sh
files.hashExcludes: the line that starts with QM_MANIFEST_BLOB=

selfCheck.scriptExcludes: the line that starts with QM_MANIFEST_BLOB=, which holds the git blob id of this manifest
selfCheck.limits: apply.sh checks this manifest and itself against each other and the other files against their blob ids. That detects damage and incomplete downloads. It does not stop someone who changes the files and the script together.

instructions.sh: sh <package folder>/apply.sh [--dry-run] [--new-branch] [--keep-bot-author] [--repo <dir-of-your-clone>], run with the package folder inside the root of your repository
instructions.cmd: <package folder>\apply.cmd [--dry-run] [--new-branch] [--keep-bot-author] (UNTESTED); a double-click works and waits for a key at the end
instructions.manual: see the last section of README_EN.txt (English) or README_CN.txt (Chinese)

verified.partA: git am --3way --keep-cr --keep-non-patch onto a scratch repository at the base commit gave the intended tree and message
